The good news is we have an unused observation wing with eight bays available for temporary clinical use. I have the authority to activate it, and given our forecast of six monitored-observation patients during the 07:00 to 13:00 surge window, I intend to activate at least six bays to meet our surge standard. Before we finalize the operating plan, I want to hear from each of you on staffing, facilities readiness, and bed management so we can get this right. Let's start with nursing staffing -- what do we need to support the required staffing ratio for six monitored-observation bays?
